jia: FYI support reported hedged requests dropped when policy still routed to a degraded region. seems telemetry lagged.
oliver: Can you drop the trace?
mira: snippet:
```
11:02:10 request=start route=us-east->us-west policy=hedge(2)
11:02:10 runtime(us-west): health=degraded cb_s=40 cap_frac=0.3
11:02:11 runtime(us-west): reject queue_full
```
jia: Policy had 30s-old health=ok and hedged anyway.
infra-bot: note: aggregated health emits every 45s; per-request hints only from sidecar.
mira: Proposal: LB injects X-Runtime-Hint header: "cb_s=40;cap_frac=0.3;degrade=0.25;ts=1700000000" plus HMAC in X-Runtime-Hint-Sig. Policy should: parse, accept if |now-ts|<2m, treat cap_frac<0.5 as low-weight for hedging and skip probes if cb_s>probe_interval.
oliver: Also add degrade penalty to scoring: score = base - w1*latency - w2*cost - w3*degrade.
qa-jen: Tests: parser unit tests, e2e with LB-injected header, chaos where runtime flips cb.
mira: Safety: gate header to internal paths, sign for Private deployments, LB will enable in canary regions first.
jia: Action items: LB: inject header + sig (mira); Policy: parse/validate + scoring tweak + probe-budget persistence (oliver); Infra: sign secret rotation (infra-bot); QA: e2e + chaos (qa-jen).
mira: I'll open a short RFC with header schema and example scoring. please review.
